items.title: Holman Bill — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I had sent a few old charts to Bob to do. He did a good job with them, good distribution, good promotion, and everything. Sold quite a few of them. So I decided to give him all the new ones too.

ctx.x: Okay. How about your publishing? Because I know as a composer, you have to have your publishing. So, how . . . ?

Yeah, well, my own companies exist strictly to collect royalties that would otherwise go to somebody else. My music is printed and distributed by Sierra Music Publications in Washington. Bob Curnow – who was also a writer for Kenton later on – owns this company. He did a great job. I hadn‟t had any luck. There was one company that had a Bill Holman series. They had a Phil Woods series, a [Bob] Brookmeyer series, and a Thad Jones series. When I made my first record with my band, the recent band, I was going to…
